theme: A day built around Mike's surgery.
greeting: Most of today belongs to Mike — his oral surgery is in Portland and you're the ride home. A quick haircut first, then a late call with Chie on where the IMC research goes next.

acts.line: A 10:00 haircut, then Mike's oral surgery in Portland — you're the one driving him home once the sedation lifts.
Held open for recovery: soft food, ice on and off, nothing that needs Mike upright.
You, Mike and Chie pick up the next stage of the IMC research over Teams.
